verified_final_point.tc: 懷疑犯罪得益，獲授權人員可在上述期間內向原訟法庭或區域法院申請第18條繼續扣留令。法院須信納合理懷疑及扣留有理據，例如進一步調查來源、考慮相關刑事程序或沒收／充公程序。每次命令期不超過自命令日起3個月；新命令不得令總扣留超過首個法院命令日起2年。
verified_final_point.en: For suspected crime proceeds, an authorized officer may apply within that period to the Court of First Instance or District Court under section 18. The court must be satisfied of reasonable suspicion and justification, such as source investigation or consideration of relevant criminal/forfeiture/confiscation proceedings. Each order permits no more than three months from its date; renewals must not take total detention beyond two years from the first court order.
